senses.gloss: a schedule showing when events, classes, or transportation services happen

definition_translations.zh_TW: 顯示活動、課程或交通服務時間的時刻表
definition_translations.ja_JP: 行事、授業、交通サービスの時刻を示す予定表
definition_translations.ko_KR: 행사, 수업, 교통 서비스가 언제 있는지 보여 주는 시간표

senses.gloss: to schedule something for a particular time
senses.example: The committee timetabled the review for next month.

translations.ja_JP: スケジュールに組む；予定を立てる
translations.th_TH: กำหนดเวลา; จัดตารางเวลา

example_translations.zh_TW: 委員會將審查排定在下個月。
example_translations.ja_JP: 委員会は審査を来月に予定しました。
example_translations.ko_KR: 위원회는 검토 일정을 다음 달로 잡았습니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Ủy ban đã lên lịch đánh giá vào tháng tới.

definition_translations.zh_TW: 將某事安排在特定時間
definition_translations.ja_JP: 何かを特定の時刻に予定する
definition_translations.ko_KR: 어떤 일을 특정 시간으로 일정에 넣다
definition_translations.vi_VN: lên lịch việc gì vào một thời điểm cụ thể
definition_translations.th_TH: กำหนดบางสิ่งไว้ในเวลาที่เฉพาะเจาะจง

translations.th_TH: ตารางเวลาทั่วไป
